entities.summary: Andrei Genadyevich Voronkov is a Russian volleyball coach and former player. As a player, he won the Turkish championships in 1996–1998, 2002 and 2004. Since 2006 he works as a volleyball coach. Between 2013 and 2015 he was head coach of the Russian men's team.
